scope: One ALFA AWUS036AXML, Windows 11 Pro build 26200, WinUSB interface 3. Representative bounded capabilities, not exhaustive options or product qualification.
interpretation: Exit 0 records script completion, not a successful capability. Nonzero attempts and recoveries are retained. Raw logs and captures remain local and ignored.
